lyrics:
[Intro: fat synth riff, live drums, handclaps]

[Verse 1: nasal emotionless male voice]
Here with my headphones on
It's the only place I'm calm
I can watch the mouths go round
I don't have to hear the sound

[Chorus: riff doubles, tambourine]
Noise cancelling
Seal goes on
Noise cancelling
Everyone's gone

[Instrumental: high synth melody over the riff]

[Verse 2: same flat delivery]
Here with the dial turned right
Trains and sirens out of sight
Someone's talking, could be you
I'll nod. That's what I do.

[Chorus: riff doubles, tambourine]
Noise cancelling
Seal goes on
Noise cancelling
Everyone's gone

[Instrumental: long synth solo, drums steady]

[Break: sudden silence, one muffled voice]
"...I said, are you coming?"

[Outro: riff returns, fades with the high melody]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 116 BPM, 4/4, A minor. Stiff, steady and cool, a machine riff with a human rhythm section.

VOICE: Male, nasal, thin and deliberately flat, with a robotic English accent and no emotion. He sings briefly and then leaves long stretches to the instruments. One muffled spoken line near the end, a woman's, heard as if through closed headphones.

INSTRUMENTS: A fat, buzzing analogue synth playing a three-note riff, a second high string-synth melody, a real drum kit played stiffly, a plain bass guitar, handclaps, tambourine.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, riff and drums. 0:20 Verse 1. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:00 Instrumental. 1:28 Verse 2. 1:52 Chorus 2. 2:08 Long synth solo. 2:48 Break, silence and the muffled line. 2:58 Outro, riff and melody fading to 3:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1979 synth rock: thick analogue synths, dry live drums, voice thin and central, no reverb to speak of.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The silence and the muffled question at 2:48.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original locks the car doors. Now the same retreat is a pair of headphones worn in a kitchen, and the song lets one sentence from outside get through.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Calm, sealed, detached, interrupted.
